body:
## Purpose

When testing `gsm8k` for DeepSeek-V4 on AMD GPUs using latest vLLM `main`, the acc value becomes `0`:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.0053|±  |0.0020|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.0008|±  |0.0008|

After reverting https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56433, the server launch failed:

```bash
File "/home/shashen/vllm/vllm/vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/scaled_mm/aiter.py", line 584, in apply_block_scaled_mm
    raise NotImplementedError(
NotImplementedError: AiterPreshuffledFp8BlockScaledMMKernel overrides apply_weights and does not use apply_block_scaled_mm.
```

After reverting https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56433 + https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51692, the acc value becomes correct:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9538|±  |0.0058|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9545|±  |0.0057|

## Test Plan

Server launch command:

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1
export AITER_LOG_LEVEL=WARNING

vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro \
    --port 8333 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
    --max-model-len 9472 \
    --max-num-seqs 512 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --async-scheduling \
    --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    --distributed-executor-backend mp \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --moe-backend aiter \
    --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 \
    --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 \
    --compilation-config '{"mode":3,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}'
```

Accuracy test with `gsm8k` dataset using `lm_eval`:

```bash
lm_eval \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=/shared/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro,base_url=http://0.0.0.0:8333/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=10,max_gen_toks=2048,timeout=60000 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --output_path . 2>&1 | tee -a eval.log

lm_eval \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=/shared/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro,base_url=http://0.0.0.0:8333/v1/completions,num_concurrent=256,max_retries=10,max_gen_toks=2048,timeout=60000 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 30 \
  --output_path . 2>&1 | tee -a eval.log
```

## Test Result

Conc=64, numshot=5 (default):

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9538|±  |0.0058|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9545|±  |0.0057|

Conc=256, numshot=30:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|    30|exact_match|↑  |0.9568|±  |0.0056|
|     |       |strict-match    |    30|exact_match|↑  |0.9575|±  |0.0056|

title: [ROCm][Bugfix] Revert #56433 + #51692 to fix accuracy breakdown for DeepSeek-V4
